caption: Grote Kerk, Veere
composition: Unfinished pale-stone basilica with a low tower roof · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: The Grote Kerk at Veere is the unfinished late-Gothic basilica in pale stone. The west tower stopped near 52 metres with a flattened roof, not the planned needle of about 100 metres. The crossing lantern was lost in the 1686 fire and was not replaced. Many window openings are filled with brick. It is overcast, about 14.6°C, with wind near 10.8 km/h and cloud cover about 100%. The church is closed. The town hall and the Campveerse Toren are other scenes and are not in this frame.
